title: Narrowing
explain: Narrowing is how TypeScript works out a more specific type inside a branch of your code. Checks like `typeof`, `in`, `instanceof` and equality all narrow the type automatically. A common pattern is a `kind` field that lets a `switch` tell union members apart.
exercise: Add a `triangle` to the Shape union and watch the compiler point at the switch that needs updating.
tip: Add a `default` branch that assigns the value to a variable of type `never`. The compiler then flags any union member you forget to handle.
